description: After a hack or a cleanup (WordPress, paid plans): run the security monitors every hour for 48 hours, pause plugin updates (with Relvato plugin 1.77.0+ that pause is a tick box in WordPress → Relvato), and alert on every unexpected change. Uses runs (get_quarantine says how many). Stopping it early stays in the dashboard.
name: start_quarantine
title: Start quarantine mode
